Shameless: the best creatives on each funnel, and whether they match the page

Meta only · Aug 17 to Sep 14 2026 · source: ejam-dwh cro_dashboard_ads, brand SHA, channel facebook, grouped by the URL the ad sent people to · every ad code opens the creative, every page name opens the live page · built Sep 16 2026

Funnels · Leaderboard · Match mechanisms · Fiber First · Variety Pack (it2) · Target · GLP-1 · Mini Bites · Swap

How to read this

  1. Rows are the page the visitor landed on. The Fiber First URL is served by two builds with identical HTML, so they are one row; /glp-1/ serves that same HTML under its own URL, so it gets its own row (it is what the visitor saw). Ads whose name carries no URL (Trybe creator posts, CC WK22 boosted posts) are placed by their build label.
  2. Match is a judgment: does the page confirm what the ad promised on the first screen? Strong match the page repeats the ad's promise. Partial match the offer carries through but the message does not. Mismatch the page ignores or contradicts the ad. Ads marked "not reviewed" were not looked at individually.
  3. Contribution = revenue + upsell − COGS − merchant fees − ad spend. CM % = contribution ÷ revenue. Goal Pacing definitions, after ad spend, first-order only, so negative is normal here (subscriptions pay back on rebills). Compare rows against each other, not against zero.
  4. Add to cart is the click from the page into checkout. $ / LP view is what a visitor costs. A visit costs about the same on every page; the cart rate is what moves CPA, and the cart rate is where match shows up.

Match mechanisms

Offer echoThe ad promises the deal the page opens with (46% off, free gifts, sells out). The visitor arrives to confirm, not to be convinced.SH-16975-2, SH-12937-7, SH-15611-1, SH-16180-1
Page quoteThe ad copy is the page headline. Zero re-orientation on landing; 64 to 67% cart.SH-18979-1, SH-18969 on Mini Bites
Retail proof loopAd says "at Target", page says "your next Target run". The claim is verified by the page before the visitor asks.SH-13376-9, SH-13376-6
Amazon contradictionThe ad sells the Amazon bestseller; the page's second reason is "flavors you won't find on Amazon". Cheapest click in the account, worst cart rate.SH-17273-9, SH-17273-4
Mindset switchA label-reader ad (calories, broccoli, fiber grams) lands on a gift-box page. Cheap traffic that came to compare, asked to buy a bundle.SH-16975-3, CC WK22 broccoli static
Ghost pageA topical URL (/glp-1/) that serves the generic page. The ad's topic has no landing, only the offer carries through.SH-14498-8, SH-14765-7

This weekKeep the four offer videos running. Move the 880-calorie cut and the broccoli static to a comparison-led page (Swap or Weight management), where the visitor's question is answered on screen one. Brief two more "unlock the sale" cuts off SH-15611-1; it is the best CM on the page at a tenth of the spend.

Shameless Snacks · best creatives by funnel, Sep 16 2026. Figures from ejam-dwh cro_dashboard_ads, Aug 17 to Sep 14 2026, brand SHA, channel facebook, ads grouped by the URL in the ad name (ads without a URL placed by lp_variant); ad tables show ads with $400+ on that page. Contribution = revenue + upsell − COGS − merchant fees − ad spend (agency fees null for the window; refunds excluded, about 2% of revenue). CM % = contribution ÷ (revenue + upsell). Add to cart = click from the landing page into checkout. Page promises fetched from the live URLs on Sep 16 2026. Ad links open the creative through the eJam asset proxy. Ads are pinned to one page by their URL, so every page-versus-page number carries that page's creative mix. The CRO dashboard attributes about 9% more spend than the creative dashboard for the same window; numbers here are the CRO dashboard's own.
